tdd_hardening.oversize_red: Before the PipeHost fix, a real 80,000-character MText caused the client to fail with Windows pipe error 109 (pipe ended).
tdd_hardening.oversize_green: After the fix, the same live scenario returns correlated RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE, preserves DBMOD across the read attempt, and a subsequent bridge.health succeeds.

acceptance_harness_note.issue: NETLOAD opens the Choose .NET Assembly dialog when FILEDIA is enabled; COM calls from SSH Session 0 cannot be used to judge the Session 1 ROT. Closing the last AutoCAD document also produced a measured acad.exe 0xc0000005 crash in the harness.
acceptance_harness_note.resolution: Run acceptance inside interactive Session 1, reuse the N2 FILEDIA=0 + quoted NETLOAD + bounded COM retry/idle pattern, and retain a clean sentinel document so the runner never closes the last document.

review_hardening.block_definition_finding: INSERT-only fingerprinting would miss edits inside a referenced block definition.
review_hardening.block_definition_resolution: Include referenced block definitions and their PID-bearing contents recursively in the snapshot with a visited-definition guard; keep document WCS extents scoped to current-space entities.
review_hardening.block_definition_proof: After saving both baseline and block-mutated drawings with DBMOD=0, the definition line changed from (2,2,0) to (3,2,0) and document_fp changed; reopening the untouched baseline restored the original fingerprint.
review_hardening.response_size_finding: A serialized snapshot can exceed the fixed 65,536-byte frame even when entity count is bounded.
review_hardening.response_size_resolution: PipeHost converts any oversized response into a small correlated RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE failure rather than dropping the connection.

decision: N4 CLOSED / LIVE PASS. Native read-only SemanticSnapshot extraction is authoritative for the supported N4 scope, including referenced block-definition content and typed oversized-response failure. N5 may now add typed native mutation with expected_parent_fp enforcement; no mutation capability is enabled by this evidence.
